svg.text: MCP tool call — sequence v1 (User asks for the weather)
Phase 2 · Per user request: call a tool
④ is a notification: no id,
⑩ The model only asks for
a tool. Host + MCP Client run it;
the model never calls the server.
when the Host sends it back (⑰)
